text:
maya: Heads up — Product asked for a consolidated KV/prefix cache dashboard. They want answers to: reuse by workload, hit/evict patterns that correlate with tail latency, and tenant-level reuse. Can eng-runtime + infra propose metrics and an ingest plan?

tomas: +1. My initial thought: we need both counter and histogram-style signals. Counters for total lookups, hits, misses, evictions; histograms for TTL/age-at-evict and reuse-interval.

elaine: agree. Also we should tag by model, route_id, workload_type (embeddings/generation/rerank), and a hashed tenant_id (to avoid PII). Minimal label set to avoid high-cardinality.

lucy: for dashboarding we usually need pre-aggregated series at 1m and 5m rollups. Can runtime push prometheus-style metrics + periodic summaries to telemetry? Or do we want a StatsD/OTel push?

tomas: runtime can export OTel metrics. Plan: expose instrumented counters and a few exemplars for tail correlation. We'll add:

```
kv_prefix_lookup_total{model,route_id,workload}  counter
kv_prefix_hit_total{...} counter
kv_prefix_eviction_total{reason,model,...} counter
kv_prefix_reuse_interval_ms_bucket{le="...",workload,...} histogram
kv_prefix_age_at_eviction_ms_bucket histogram
kv_prefix_warmup_latency_ms_bucket histogram (cold→first-hit)
kv_prefix_tenant_reuse_ratio gauge (per-tenant sample)
```

maya: That looks good. Two questions: 1) sampling for tenant_reuse_ratio (we can't tag every tenant) and 2) eviction reasons — we need at least "capacity", "ttl", "idle_eviction", "manually_pinned".

elaine: For tenant sampling, propose deterministic hash-sample: include tenant_id when hash % 100 == 0 (1% sample) and send tenant_reuse_ratio as gauge. On the ingest side we store only hashed id. Works for SLOs without PII.

tomas: eviction reasons ok. We'll emit reason label with low-cardinality values. Also add sequence_length_bucket label for requests (short/medium/long) to correlate reuse with seq len distribution.

lucy: On dashboard panels:
- global hit rate timeseries (1m/5m) with weighted by lookups
- eviction rate + stacked by reason
- reuse_by_workload: heatmap (workload x model) of reuse_ratio
- tenant-heavy tail list: top 50 sampled tenants by miss rate
- warmup latency p50/p95/p99 by model

maya: UX-wise product also wants an explainer (tooltip) that defines reuse_ratio: (#prefix_hits_within_T / #prefix_lookups) over 24h window and a note about sample bias.

elaine: Telemetry ingest constraints: we should avoid high-cardinality label combos. Recommend metrics to be emitted with these labels: {model,route_id,workload,seq_bucket,evict_reason?} and keep tenant_id only for sampled tenant_reuse_ratio gauge. We'll also add an annotation event stream for canary rollouts that affect caching behavior.

tomas: Implementation plan:
1) runtime: add counters/histograms and sampling logic (PR in eng-runtime repo).
2) infra: add OTel pipeline to ingest these metrics, convert histograms -> prometheus/TSDB, and maintain 1m/5m rollups.
3) platform: dashboard + alert rules (miss rate increase > 10% sustained or eviction spike).

lucy: alert thresholds: baseline hit_rate per-workload/model; create dynamic alert: if hit_rate drops > 15% relative to 7d baseline for 10m, page on P2. Eviction spike alert: eviction_rate increase > x. We'll define numeric thresholds after first 48h of data.

maya: timeline? Product wants a beta dashboard for the next release (~2 weeks). Is that doable?

tomas: 2 weeks is tight but feasible if we scope: only global timeseries + reuse_by_workload heatmap + eviction stacked. Skip tenant list for beta.

elaine: infra can wire basic ingest and rollups in 1 week if runtime emits stable metric names. We'll need a short RFC/PR for naming + sampling.

maya: action items:
- tomas: open eng-runtime PR with metric names + sampling code (due EOD Thu).
- elaine: add ingest pipeline config + sample retention / rollup plan (due Mon).
- lucy: prototype Grafana dashboard with mock data, link in thread (due Mon).

infra-bot: Reminder set: "kv-metrics-rfc" due in 72h.

lucy: ok I'll put a mock panel and set up board with placeholders.

tomas: quick sample of sampling pseudocode to include in PR:

```python
# deterministic 1% tenant sample
if hash(tenant_id) % 100 == 0:
    emit_gauge("kv_prefix_tenant_reuse_ratio", value, {"tenant_hash": sha256(tenant_id)[:8]})

# counters
emit_counter("kv_prefix_lookup_total", 1, labels)
if hit:
    emit_counter("kv_prefix_hit_total", 1, labels)
else:
    emit_counter("kv_prefix_miss_total", 1, labels)
```

maya: this looks great. Keep labels minimal. After beta we'll expand to tenant list and exemplar traces for root-cause.

elaine: noted. I'll coordinate retention: histograms 30d raw, rollups 90d, aggregates 1y.

maya: thanks all — please update this thread with PR/links. We'll demo beta next Wed during infra sync. :thumbsup:
